entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts 2017 mise à jour 2023 + LF 2025 (scanned)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contribution des patentes (rate of the turnover class on the whole turnover)
entries.statute: CGI 2017 mis à jour 2023 art. 189; LF 2025, LFR 2024-2025 and LF 2026 as held contain no patente amendment (budget pages only partly OCR'd)
entries.doc: art. 189: the patente is a rate on the previous year's declared turnover, by class: 4th class 30-100 M 1,00 %; 3rd class 100 000 001 to 1 bn 0,60 %; 2nd class 1 000 000 001 to 10 bn 0,45 %; 1st class above 10 bn 0,20 % (rate of the class on the whole turnover).
unsupported: turnover below 30 M (outside the classes of art. 189)
assessment at ten times the purchases when no accounts (art. 190)

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: CF: the general tax code held (cgi2023.txt, 955k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: CF: the general tax code held (cgi2023.txt) has no charging provision on net wealth (full-text search 'impôt sur la fortune / le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net'); edition as held, later finance laws not all checked

entries.name: Taxe de circulation des véhicules à moteur (by fiscal horsepower)
entries.statute: CGI 2017 mis à jour 2023 art. 245 bis, 245 bis 1 (LF 2018)
unsupported: category A motorcycles of 150 cm3 and more (5 000 F)

entries.name: IRPP on income from movable capital, dividends (15 % of gross)
entries.statute: CGI 2017, official edition updated 2023 (DGID), art. 84 (LF 2025 OCR pp. 1-60 checked: art. 84 not amended; the rest of LF 2025 not read)
entries.doc: art. 84: the IRPP due on income from movable capital received by individuals is liquidated at 15 % of the gross income distributed; art. 116: withheld at source monthly by the payer.

entries.name: IRPP on income from movable capital, interest on claims, deposits and current accounts (15 %)
entries.doc: art. 49: income from claims, deposits, cash guarantees and current accounts is income from movable capital; art. 50: on the gross interest; art. 84: 15 %.

entries.name: Contribution foncière des propriétés bâties (15 % of rental value less 40 %, at least 30 000 F; main home exempt)
entries.doc: art. 170: base = rental value less 40 % for wear and upkeep; art. 177: 15 % for individuals and bodies not liable to IS (30 % for IS payers), at least 30 000 F; art. 169 12°: the first dwelling occupied as main residence by the owner or family is exempt (the household's home), other buildings taxed.
unsupported: rental value not below 12 % of market value or cost (art. 172)

entries.name: Contribution foncière des propriétés non bâties (27,5 % of 12 % of market value in urban centres)
entries.doc: art. 180 a): in urban centres the taxable income is 12 % of the market value; art. 184: rate 27,5 % — i.e. 3,3 % of the market value, applied in one step.
unsupported: rural land assessed per hectare (art. 180 b)
rounding to the nearest 10 F and the two-step rounding of 12 % then 27,5 %

entries.name: Droit d'enregistrement, mutations d'immeubles bâtis (7,5 %)
entries.doc: art. 77: sales of immovables are subject to the high rate (15 %, art. 301); art. 301 reduces it to 7,5 % for deeds and transfers of built immovables and to 6 % for urban unbuilt and rural built immovables.

entries.name: Droit d'enregistrement, mutations d'immeubles urbains non bâtis (6 %)
entries.doc: art. 301: 6 % for deeds and transfers of urban unbuilt immovables (land taken as urban).
unsupported: rural unbuilt land and concessions of State land at the 15 % rate of art. 77

entries.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (successions, donations)
entries.why: art. 304 tariff per net share by degree; art. 306 shared abatement of 5 M F plus 3 M F per child or dependent ascendant across direct-line heirs and spouse, art. 308 reductions for children: the household input carries neither the number of children nor the shared abatement

entries.name: CNSS employer contributions (pensions 4 %, work injury 3 %, family and maternity 12 %; up to 600 000 FCFA a month)
entries.statute: US SSA, Social Security Programs Throughout the World (SSPTW), Africa 2019, Central African Republic (Wayback 2020-08-02, R4/fetch/p14/ssptw_central-african-republic.txt): employer 4 % (old age), 3 % (work injury), 12 % (family allowances, also maternity), each with maximum monthly earnings of 600,000 CFA francs; official secondary, edition 2019 (flagged)
entries.doc: 4 + 3 + 12 = 19 % of wages up to 600 000 FCFA a month per employee. Fourteenth pass (FT reviewer 4: family not modelled).
unsupported: the minimum base (legal minimum wage 35 000 FCFA)
